home.titleLead: I build websites, bots and scripts.

about.title: About
about.statement: I'm 23, and for more than five of those years I've been building websites, bots and scripts for clients.
about.p1: I'm not a studio and not a team. You discuss the task with the same person who writes the code — no account manager in between and no "let me check with the developers".
about.p2: I work with small businesses, startups and organisations that need one person for the whole job: from the first conversation to a working site or bot.

progress.text: You get a link to a working version, not status reports.

handover.title: I launch and hand over access
